newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone-Poulenc says did not give figures.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc says did not give figures.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc said in a statement that it was not the source for a story published on Reuters earlier on Tuesday concerning its 1996 results.
Reuters quoted a source close to the company on Tuesday as saying that its 1996 net attributable profit would be 20 to 25 percent higher than the 2.134 billion francs of 1995.
Rhone-Poulenc had initially declined to comment ahead of the January 30 publication of its annual figures.
The statement said: "Rhone-Poulenc clarifies that it is not the source of the information concerning the 1996 results published this morning at 0859 GMT by Reuters."

"As the consolidation of data regarding the group's various businesses worldwide is currently underway, no figures are available," it said, adding it would publish its results on January 30 at 0730 GMT.
